title: Marketplace detail pages — first drafts in the modern style

steps.path: Marketplace → click any plugin card (here: Civic Report)
steps.headline: Three ways to arrange the same detail page. Which should every Marketplace page use?
steps.notice: All three use the same pieces as Settings and Session details: a popup with the ✕, a top card about the item, then labelled cards. Only the arrangement differs.
steps.risk: Whichever you pick applies to plugins, skills, connections, themes and integrations alike.

variants.label: One column
variants.summary: Every section is its own labelled card, all open, one under another — like Account or Backup & sync.
variants.risk: Long pages (a bundle with 14 skills) need a lot of scrolling.

variants.label: Two columns
variants.summary: A wider popup: the reading (About, What's inside, Feedback) on the left, the short facts (What this can do, Source) on the right.
variants.risk: A new arrangement no other popup uses yet; on a phone it falls back to one column.

variants.label: Folded
variants.summary: What this can do stays open; About, What's inside, Feedback and Source become fold-out rows in one card — like About's Privacy card.
variants.risk: One more click to read the description or the comments.

steps.headline: A plugin page is now a normal popup: a top card about the plugin, then labelled cards.
steps.changed: The near-full-screen panel with 'Details' and 'Esc · Close' became the shared popup titled 'Plugin details' with the ✕. Name, Installed pill, star and share sit in one card with the chips and the button.
steps.notice: Chips (safety, source, author, installs, % helpful) are one row that fades at the end instead of wrapping. Everything else sits in a labelled card, nothing loose on the background.
steps.risk: The popup is narrower than before (600px wide), so long descriptions are taller.

steps.headline: What's inside a bundle is now a list of rows you can open, each with its one-line description.
steps.changed: The comma list of dotted-underlined names became one row per skill (name, description, arrow), grouped as 'Skills 14', 'Commands 1'.
steps.notice: Click a row to open that skill's own page, as before. Hooks and connections show as plain rows.
steps.risk: A bundle with many skills makes this card long.

steps.headline: A skill from a bundle shows 'Part of Superpowers' as a row that opens the bundle's page.
steps.changed: The dotted-underlined 'Part of Superpowers' link in the chip line became a row inside the top card. The popup is titled 'Skill details'.
steps.notice: Comments are each in their own box now, with no lines running across the card.

steps.path: Marketplace → Browser Use (the automatic check flagged it)
steps.headline: What the safety check flagged is now the amber warning box, inside 'What this can do'.
steps.changed: The flagged list was separated by a line and amber dots; it is now the same warning box Backup & sync uses. Install is one full-width filled button.
steps.notice: If an install fails, the reason now shows in a red notice inside the top card with its own Retry button, instead of only in a hover tooltip.
steps.risk: The install-failed notice is not shown here; it needs a failing install to appear.

steps.path: Marketplace → Filesystem (a connection that can't be installed from the app)
steps.headline: A listing you can't install here says so inside its card, above an 'Open source' button.
steps.changed: The blue notice moved from between sections into the top card; 'Open source' is a full-width outlined button. The popup is titled 'Connection details'.
steps.notice: The Source card lists where it comes from (with an Open button), its licence and the checked version, with the explanation written out instead of a hover tooltip.
steps.risk: The author chip is cut off by the fade when the name is long.

steps.headline: A theme page: top card with like, star and share, then a Preview card holding the picture and colours.
steps.changed: Uninstall was bare text; it is now an outlined button left of the filled 'Apply theme'. The theme in use shows an 'In use' pill instead of a greyed 'Active' button.
steps.notice: The colour swatches sit inside the Preview card, under the picture, instead of loose under it.
steps.risk: Three buttons when an update is available (Uninstall, Update, Apply theme).

steps.path: Marketplace → Themes → Cotton Candy Sky (not installed)
steps.headline: A theme you don't have yet: one full-width Install button in the top card.
steps.changed: Install moved from the top right of the page into the top card, full width, the way every lone main button looks in popups.
steps.notice: Star is greyed until it is installed, as before; like and share work right away.

steps.path: Marketplace → Connect your stuff → Google Workspace
steps.headline: Integration pages now match plugin pages: same popup, same top card, same labelled cards.
steps.changed: This page was a separate older copy (bigger 'Integration' header, a full line under it, an amber-text pill, a dead 'Settings (Coming soon…)' button). The dead button is gone; Uninstall and Connect sit right.
steps.notice: Setup facts are rows in a Setup card instead of bullets. After connecting, the 'run this command' message is a blue notice with Dismiss, Copy and Open new setup session inside it.
steps.risk: The integration's coloured outline around the whole popup is gone; its colour now shows only on its icon.

steps.path: Marketplace on a phone (390 wide) → Civic Report
steps.headline: On a phone the page is the same popup, a little narrower, with buttons full width.
steps.changed: Before, the panel filled the whole phone screen with its own header. Now it is the shared popup at phone size.
steps.notice: The chip row shows what fits and fades; when there are two buttons they stack, filled one on top.
steps.risk: Fewer chips are visible on a phone because the row never wraps.

steps.path: Marketplace in a small window (640 by 480) → Civic Report
steps.headline: In a small window the popup shrinks with it and the body scrolls under a soft fade.
steps.changed: Same popup as the full-size window; its height follows the window.
steps.notice: The header and the ✕ stay put while the cards scroll.
steps.risk: Only the top card and part of the first card fit before scrolling.

steps.path: Any installed plugin's page, top card
steps.headline: When Uninstall is the only button, should it stay full width?
steps.today: In the drafts an installed plugin's only button, Uninstall, is an outlined button across the whole top card.
steps.problem: The guide says a lone button is full width, but that makes Uninstall the biggest thing on the page even though it is the action people want least.
steps.proposal: Pick how a lone, less important button should look on these pages.

options.label: Full width
pros: Follows the guide's lone-button rule exactly
Same as every other single-button card
cons: Uninstall looks like the main thing to do

options.label: Small, at the right
cons: A second look for lone buttons; the guide would need a line for it

steps.path: Any detail page, the popup's title line
steps.headline: Should the popup's title say the kind ('Plugin details') or the item's name ('Civic Report')?
steps.today: The drafts title the popup by kind — 'Plugin details', 'Theme details' — and show the name large in the top card, like Session details.
steps.problem: The name then appears once, but the title line only says what kind of thing it is.
steps.proposal: Choose what the title line says on every Marketplace detail page.

options.label: The kind
pros: Tells you what you opened (plugin, skill, connection)
cons: The item's name is only in the card below

options.label: The item's name
pros: The name stays visible while you scroll
cons: The name would show twice unless the top card drops it
